prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent foliage texture for architectural 3D vegetation cards. Create ONE irregular dense leafy canopy branch cluster of a mature evergreen camphor / broadleaf park tree, isolated on a fully transparent alpha background. Photorealistic small green leaves in many orientations, delicate twig structure, natural small see-through gaps and a feathery irregular edge. The cluster is roughly oval but asymmetrical, fills about 80 percent of a square, and has clear transparent margin on all four edges. Many tiny leaves, not a handful of large leaves. Muted olive and medium natural green palette, soft neutral daylight and subtle leaf shading; no dramatic sun direction or strong cast shadow. View straight at the cluster with no perspective ground. Only leaves and thin branches: no trunk, no ground, no pot, no landscape, no sky, no text, no frame, no logo, no visible checkerboard. True transparent background for alpha cutout, do not paint a white or green rectangle.
